name: Lubims
overview: The Lubims are identified in Scripture as inhabitants of northern Africa, specifically linked to the region known as Phut, which is also called Libya. Biblical references associate the Lubims with other northern African peoples such as Phut and Put, who are described as allies or helpers in the context of ancient conflicts. Their presence in passages like Ezekiel 27:10 and Nahum 3:9 highlights their role among the nations surrounding Israel, while Acts 2:10 situates them geographically near Cyrene in Libya, emphasizing their place in the broader biblical narrative of nations.
